name: What is the typical process for a deck replacement project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a deck replacement project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our deck replacement process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your current structure. Following this, we develop a comprehensive design plan, often including CAD-supported layouts, that integrates seamlessly with your home's architecture. Once the design is finalized and approved, we handle all necessary permit coordination. Construction then proceeds with meticulous craftsmanship, managed by a single, accountable team. We prioritize clear communication throughout, ensuring scheduling transparency and regular updates until the final walkthrough, delivering a high-end outdoor living space that meets our stringent standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial consultation, comprehensive design with CAD layouts, permit coordination, meticulous construction by a single team, and clear communication through to the final walkthrough.
